title: ebenus major
intro: Ebenus major, commonly known as Burnet or Great Burnet, is a perennial herbaceous plant in the family Rosaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to act as a diuretic, helping to remove excess fluids from the body, and its antimicrobial properties, which may aid in the treatment of infections. The bioactive constituents of Ebenus major include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
